content.title: Peter Schiff Says Silver Investors Are In 'Denial' As Mining Stocks Continue To Lag: 'Should Have Doubled' In December
content.summary: Economist Peter Schiff is calling out the glaring disconnect between the surging price of silver and the market’s reaction to key silver mining stocks. These Stocks ‘Should Have Doubled’ In December On Tuesday, in a series of posts on X, Schiff, a long-time advocate of hard assets and precious metals, pointed out that while silver, tracked by the iShares Silver Trust (NYSE:SLV) surged 35% in December, the Global X Silver Miners ETF (NYSE:SIL), which tracks prominent silver miners, is up just 11%
